note: The wet band, measured where it is wide. Every attempt to read it from the bank is a two-pixel strip and a box average paints it back to its neighbours, so this camera is DOWN at the water — 10 cm above the surface, in the middle of the basin, looking at the north wall: a metre of tile, of which the wet band is a quarter, and nothing in front of it. `?wet=0` is the control, where the wet materials are painted back to the numbers of the dry ones they copy.
